messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Nothing's changed since this morning, Trent. Shop···· is your Magic Miner 40T, paid and still at the warehouse. It ships November 14, 2026, and tracking goes to this email the moment it leaves.

You can watch that batch come in here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates there move a little as stock shifts between warehouses.

Your B30 on Shop···· is still October 30, so that one lands first. Anything else you want me to check?
Before you go, one thing: once the solar's on, is the PunkHash still the plan, or has something else caught your eye?
